words.sense: Shortness of speech or writing, without necessarily implying unfriendly tone.
misconceptions: A short polite response must be terse.

words.sense: Extreme shortness of speech or writing, often sounding curt or abrupt.
misconceptions: A clipped answer is no different from efficient concision.

semantic_axes.description: Whether the notable feature is economy of words or sharply clipped, abrupt expression.

edges.boundary_rule: Brevity is simply shortness; terseness adds a notably abrupt or curt manner.

misconceptions.M1: A short polite response must be terse.
misconceptions.M2: A clipped answer is no different from efficient concision.
misconceptions.M3: Tone does not matter when choosing between the words.
